description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans membership table operations using PostgreSQL as the storage backend. It defines a test class with various test methods to verify functionality such as inserting, reading, updating, and cleaning up membership data in PostgreSQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans membership table operations with PostgreSQL backend.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filters for the test class.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of the membership table using PostgreSQL configuration.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates a gateway list provider configured for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the ADO.NET invariant name for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up a test database instance and returns its connection string.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_Init
methods.description: Placeholder test for initializing the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_GetGateways
methods.description: Tests retrieving gateway list from the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Tests reading all entries from an empty PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_InsertRow
methods.description: Tests inserting a row into the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Tests reading a row after inserting it into the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Tests reading all entries after inserting multiple into the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_UpdateRow
methods.description: Tests updating a row in the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Tests concurrent updates to a row in the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_PostgreSql_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Tests updating the 'I am alive' status in the PostgreSQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTablePostgreSql_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Tests cleanup of defunct silo entries in the PostgreSQL membership table.
